The Kuartz

Condominium in Karon
HomeSaleThe Kuartz

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Two seven-storey residential buildings at Karon Beach, with architecture inspired by quartz facets and ocean curves.

The site is about 4,400 sqm with roughly 86 car parking spaces including EV spaces. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

The Kuartz: key facts

  • The Kuartz is a condominium in Karon, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 32–62.9 sqm.
  • Construction status: pre-sale.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿5,806,306.
  • Nearest beach: Karon Beach (1.0 km / 2 minutes, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Patong Hospital (5.4 km, straight line); Chalong Hospital (5.5 km, straight line); Makro (2.2 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (4.1 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala.
